$comment: Structured task inventory for the agentic harness (docs/agentic/harness.md). Statuses: pending | in_progress | completed. Never mark completed without running the verification_steps; record outcomes in docs/agentic/progress.md.

features.description: Enforce canonical runtime policy: Python 3.11+, Node.js 22+ (24 LTS recommended) across docs, setup scripts, CI, and package.json engines.
features.user_value: New contributors and CI run on one consistent, supported toolchain; no setup failures from contradictory docs.
verification_steps: grep -rn -E 'Python 3\.10|Node(\.js)? 1[68]|Node(\.js)? 20' README.md AGENT.md CLAUDE.md CONTRIBUTING.md docs/user/ dev.ps1 dev.bat .github/ returns nothing
python3 scripts/docs_lint.py passes
CI frontend jobs run on node-version 22

features.description: dev.ps1 offers automatic Python 3.11 installation via winget (prompt defaults to Yes), refreshes PATH from registry, re-checks with the same detection function, and falls back to manual instructions on any failure.
features.user_value: Non-technical Windows users can go from zero to running app with one double-click even without Python installed.
verification_steps: PowerShell AST parse of dev.ps1 reports no errors
Manual: run dev.ps1 on a machine without Python and confirm the winget path, the [Y/n] prompt, and the fallback messages

features.description: Documented, repeatable agent loop: docs/agentic/{harness,evals,mcp-tools,roadmap,progress}.md plus this feature inventory, so any future agent session can resume from repo state alone.
features.user_value: Project demonstrates production agentic-engineering practice; work survives context resets and model changes.
verification_steps: All five docs/agentic files exist and pass python3 scripts/docs_lint.py
python3 scripts/generate_docs_index.py --check passes

features.description: Consolidated AI-safety policy doc (docs/compliance/ai-safety.md): refusal/escalation boundaries, grounding and citation requirements, uncertainty handling, emergency disclaimers, and pointers to the prompt-injection and PHI-leakage evals.
features.user_value: Reviewers and contributors see the non-diagnostic product boundary and how it is enforced in code and CI, not just claimed.
verification_steps: docs/compliance/ai-safety.md exists, is linked from docs/compliance/README.md, and every code/test path it cites resolves
python3 scripts/agent_eval_gate.py exits 0

features.description: Expand the adversarial eval set: dedicated prompt-injection corpus (instructions embedded in uploaded documents and memory items) and PHI-leakage probes on every export path, wired into scripts/agent_eval_gate.py or a sibling gate.
features.user_value: Injection and leakage resistance become regression-tested guarantees instead of one-time reviews.
verification_steps: New pytest cases (HC-XXX-NNN naming) fail when an injection succeeds or an export leaks unredacted text
Gate runs in CI and blocks merge on regression

features.description: Data-quality test suite and extraction eval card: labeled golden set of lab PDFs (synthetic), precision/recall on analyte, unit, date extraction; published as docs/agentic/eval-cards/extraction.md with versioned metrics.
features.user_value: Extraction accuracy is measured, tracked over time, and demonstrable — core Data Science portfolio evidence.
verification_steps: Golden-set pytest suite runs in CI with explicit thresholds
Eval card records metric, dataset version, and date for each run

features.description: Observability gap-closure (most of the stack already exists: CorrelationIdMiddleware, /health route, MetricsCollector p50/p95/p99, TimingMiddleware, DB audit logging). Remaining: (1) correlation ID injected into log records via a logging.Filter in a new core/logging_setup.py, and into SecurityAuditMiddleware's JSON payload; (2) optional JSON log format behind a settings flag (stdlib only); (3) an e2e step hitting the running backend's /health.
features.user_value: Failures in real use are diagnosable from logs without violating the no-network guarantee.
verification_steps: tests/monitoring/test_correlation.py asserts log records carry the correlation ID
tests/security/test_audit_middleware.py asserts the audit JSON payload carries it
e2e smoke hits /health and asserts 200 + status field

features.description: Packaging phase 0 — decision spike doc (docs/plans/<date>-packaging-decision.md): PyInstaller+Tauri vs PyInstaller+Electron vs portable folder + launcher. Criteria: SQLCipher/llama-cpp native bundling, model download-on-first-run, code signing, size. Prepared recommendation: portable folder first.
features.user_value: Distribution decisions are recorded with tradeoffs before any packaging code exists.
verification_steps: Decision doc exists, passes docs lint, and names a chosen path with rationale

features.description: Packaging phase 1 — frozen backend proof: PyInstaller spec for main:app + uvicorn with hidden imports (sqlcipher3, llama-cpp, sentence-transformers).
features.user_value: The backend runs on a machine with no Python installed.
verification_steps: Frozen exe boots on a clean Windows VM, /health returns 200, a vault opens

features.description: Packaging phase 2 — frontend static build served by the frozen backend (FastAPI StaticFiles) + end-user launcher + first-run model download flow; Node is no longer a runtime dependency.
features.user_value: One folder, one launcher — no developer toolchain for patients.
verification_steps: Full app usable from the packaged folder on a clean VM with no Node/Python installed

features.description: Packaging phase 3 — docs/agile/DISTRIBUTION_CHECKLIST.md (RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md is the agent-overhaul acceptance gate, not distribution): clean-VM install test, signing decision, upgrade/uninstall path, data-directory location.
features.user_value: Every release ships against an explicit, verifiable distribution checklist.
verification_steps: Checklist exists; each item names a verifying command or manual step

features.description: Implement the local script tools from docs/agentic/mcp-tools.md (run_tests, run_lint, run_typecheck, run_e2e, check_docs_versions) as thin, credential-free wrappers; add read-only SQLite/SQLCipher inspection for synthetic dev vaults.
features.user_value: Agents verify work through narrow, auditable interfaces instead of ad-hoc shell, reducing risky tool calls.
verification_steps: Each wrapper exits nonzero on underlying failure (spot-check by injecting a failing test)
DB tool rejects write statements

features.description: Wire a real NLI cross-encoder (candidate: cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-xsmall, MIT, ~22M params, via the existing sentence-transformers dependency) to populate the existing-but-never-fed entailment_scores parameter in modules/faithfulness.py and make verifier_agent.py's use_llm_entailment flag route to a real implementation instead of its stub. Additive: regex scoring remains the floor; flag defaults off. Verified 2026-07-07: production faithfulness is 100% rule-based today (consistency_score hardcoded 1.0; _check_entailment_llm is a stub). Depends on non-GGUF model-distribution support in scripts/download_models.py. Touches two ask-before-touching files — requires its own owner approval when scheduled.
features.user_value: Faithfulness scoring gains a semantic signal instead of regex-only matching, reducing missed hallucinations in assistant outputs.
verification_steps: With the flag on, a synthetic contradicted claim scores below threshold where regex-only scoring passed it
With the flag off (default), all existing faithfulness/verifier tests pass unchanged
Offline test proves no network access at inference time (model loaded from local path)

features.description: Rename the product (owner decision 2026-07-07): 'HealthCentral' collides with healthcentral.com. Stage 1 DONE — surface audit + screened shortlist at docs/plans/2026-07-07-rename-audit-and-shortlist.md. Stage 2 (manual, blocking): owner picks a candidate and clears it against USPTO TESS/domains/app stores. Stage 3: one PR changing user-visible strings only (internal HC_*/HC-* identifiers and DB filenames kept).
features.user_value: Avoids trademark risk before the project is shown publicly as a product.
verification_steps: Owner clearance recorded in docs/agentic/progress.md
After rename: grep for old name returns only historical docs and kept internal identifiers; app boots with new title; tsc/vitest/docs gates pass
